CURRENT RELEASES: https://fallingethics.bandcamp.com/album/dreams-versus-nightmares — four P.E.A.R.L. tracks released 2026-09-04 screened but excluded as already PARKED material from an earlier run.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://noidrecords.bandcamp.com/album/out-of-boundaries — four Caotical Disordah tracks from March 2026 screened; broken-rhythm/heavy-bass language remained release-level rather than track-specific.
ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://refractionrecords.bandcamp.com/album/va-prism-ep — seven label-compilation tracks screened; broken/deep/dub framing remained compilation-level.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://refractionrecords.bandcamp.com/album/konomo-invisible-ep — all four Konomo tracks from January 2026 screened; Invisible retained from its exact-track broken-beat and closing-flow description.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://mentalgroove.bandcamp.com/album/planetary-invazion-ep — four Super Nova reissue tracks screened; release-level off-kilter techno/electro context did not isolate an exact lead.
OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://patternsofperception.bandcamp.com/album/deformation — four Abby Echiverri tracks screened; groove/shuffle/psychedelic language remained EP-level.

BOUNDED QUERIES: September 2026 Bandcamp techno, hypnotic, broken-beat, syncopated and polyrhythmic result windows plus current Juno back-catalogue listings; exact Spotify identities intentionally left to the repository resolver.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 43 named tracks across ten release/catalogue pages plus bounded current-release and adjacent-result windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 12 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejections and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Run 48 brenner material and Run 47 DT229 were not recycled.
The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and its two listener-protected handoffs remain untouched; every proposed placement follows the intact block.
Hollen — Warm Shuffle supplied a current exact title and groove/hypnotic tags but no track-level behavioural evidence; title and tags did not become sonic facts.
OSCMAN — Mirage had an exact-track hypnotic-groove description, but its straightforward forward-driving hypothesis was weaker for this run than the three ranked leads and was not used as padding.
P.E.A.R.L. material was already present in the PARKED queue and was excluded without new evidence or a triggered revisit.
Caotical Disordah, the Prism compilation, Super Nova and Abby Echiverri supplied useful release-level corridors but insufficient exact-track behavioural evidence for a stronger lead.
No lead was promoted for recency, genre tag, artist reputation, BPM proximity, title or novelty. Energy, density, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Konomo — Invisible (Original Mix): exact-track label description names a broken-beat framework, subtle flow and a closing/immersive function; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.
2. Holly Lester — Big Fill: exact-track label description names rolling sub, groove, pressure and moments of suspended space; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

3. leo — Descant: RA identifies the album's movement into broken techno at Descant and the official page verifies the exact July 2026 track; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.
